scenario.title: Split customer_features into three separately-scanned CTEs
scenario.description: A "readability" refactor that scans orders three times and adds two joins.

consumers.sql: select * from {{ ref('rpt_customer_segments') }} order by customer_count desc
select * from {{ ref('rpt_daily_kpis') }} order by ship_date
select nation_name, ship_month, sum(net_revenue) as net_revenue from {{ ref('mart_revenue_by_nation') }} group by 1, 2

main.name: customer_features
main.sql:
with orders as (
    select customer_key, order_key, order_date, total_price
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
)
select
    customer_key,
    count(*)         as order_count,
    sum(total_price) as lifetime_value,
    avg(total_price) as avg_order_value,
    min(order_date)  as first_order_date,
    max(order_date)  as last_order_date,
    
        (date_diff('day', max(order_date)::timestamp, cast('1998-08-02' as date)::timestamp ))
     as days_since_last_order
from orders
group by customer_key

main.name: dim_customers
main.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    coalesce(f.order_count, 0) as order_count,
    f.lifetime_value,
    f.avg_order_value,
    f.first_order_date,
    f.last_order_date,
    f.days_since_last_order
from "lab"."prod"."stg_customers" c
left join "lab"."ci_main"."customer_features" f on f.customer_key = c.customer_key

main.name: mart_revenue_by_nation
main.sql:
select
    c.nation_name,
    c.region_name,
    date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date) as ship_month,
    count(distinct ol.order_key)                    as order_count,
    sum(ol.net_revenue)                             as net_revenue
from "lab"."prod"."int_order_lines" ol
join "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers" c on c.customer_key = ol.customer_key
group by 1, 2, 3
having date_trunc('month', ol.ship_date)
       >= date_trunc('month', cast(

    (cast('1998-08-02' as date) + cast(-3 as bigint) * interval 1 month) as date))

main.name: rpt_customer_segments
main.sql:
select
    market_segment,
    nation_name,
    count(*)            as customer_count,
    avg(lifetime_value) as avg_lifetime_value,
    sum(order_count)    as order_count
from "lab"."ci_main"."dim_customers"
group by 1, 2

pr.name: customer_features
pr.sql:
with order_counts as (
    select customer_key, count(*) as order_count
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
    group by customer_key
),
order_values as (
    select customer_key, sum(total_price) as lifetime_value, avg(total_price) as avg_order_value
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
    group by customer_key
),
order_recency as (
    select customer_key, min(order_date) as first_order_date, max(order_date) as last_order_date
    from "lab"."prod"."stg_orders"
    where order_date <= cast('1998-08-02' as date)
    group by customer_key
)
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.order_count,
    v.lifetime_value,
    v.avg_order_value,
    r.first_order_date,
    r.last_order_date,
    
        (date_diff('day', r.last_order_date::timestamp, cast('1998-08-02' as date)::timestamp ))
     as days_since_last_order
from order_counts c
join order_values v on v.customer_key = c.customer_key
join order_recency r on r.customer_key = c.customer_key
